newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ wholesale electricity prices rise in January.
newsitem.headline: NZ wholesale electricity prices rise in January.

text.p: Average wholesale New Zealand electricity prices in January rose in both the North and South Islands compared with December prices, electricity market operator EMCO said on Thursday.
The average wholesale electricity price for the South Island (at the Benmore reference point) in January rose to 3.17 cents per kilowatt hour compared with 2.62 cents in December.
In the North Island (at the Haywards reference point), the average price rose to 4.10 cents a kilowatt hour from 3.64 cents in December.
The prices compared to November's 2.82 cents (South Island) and 4.27 cents (North Island).
The highest South Island price in January was 4.52 cents (10.45 cents in December) and the lowest price was 1.95 cents (0.10 cents in December).
The highest North Island price in January was 13.77 cents compared with 15.01 cents in December. The lowest price was 2.11 cents compared with 0.11 cents in December.
EMCO said final prices for February were due to be published on or before March 12.
